load_hydra_config: load a Hydra config from a path and convert mask indices to mask pattern names
get_ckpt_path: get the checkpoint path with the highest step number from a folder of PyTorch checkpoint files
get_cfg_hash: compute an MD5 hash of a Hydra config object serialized to YAML

set_seed_everywhere: set a random seed across PyTorch, CUDA, NumPy, and Python random modules
